name: Lahore GPO and High Court
assumptions: The frame heading is 103.6, the normal of the OSM porch edge, confirmed on the image; the dossier's 166.6 is a footprint axis, as its note says.

GPO front width 38.6 m from the tower spacing on the Esri image (32.9 m) and the head-on photo; Dawn's 130 ft (39.6 m) agrees. The OSM ring omits the outer halves of the towers and is replaced on the front only.
Scale: 34.3 mm per pixel of the head-on photo at the tower plane. Eaves 10.7 m, first floor line 5.25 m, front towers 17.7 m to the finial, all derived from that; no source gives a height.
Clock tower top 26 m, corrected for perspective from photos; its position 11 m behind the front is read from the image, with satellite lean, and could be off by 3 m.
OSM traces the roofs; the image lean suggests feet could sit about 2.5 m south-east of them. Not corrected, so the model stays on OSM.

Wing bay count is one arch per 4.5 m, estimated from the Dawn wing photo; the courtyard faces and wing ends are not photographed: courtyard arcades are copied from the outer faces, seen as brick arches on the image.
Mid-wing gables are shown on the outer faces in photos; none is drawn on the courtyard side because none is seen.
Wing-end towers: positions from the image and the painting; drawn smaller than the front towers, heights estimated.
The separate rear range closing the GPO courtyard on the west is a different OSM building, not part of this model; lawn, fountain and red boundary fence are outside the OSM ring and left out.
Clock face drawn on the front only; the other three faces are not seen. Corner turrets on the clock stage simplified.

High Court: all positions come from the Esri image and OSM side blocks; only one exterior photo (from the Mall, north-east) was found. Heights scale from the 16.8 m tower spacing on the image: towers 29.4 m to the finial, eaves 10 m, gable 15.8 m.
High Court ground storey arcades: pointed arches from one close NPR view; bay count and the upper storey blank walls are estimates. Rear and side elevations are plain walls.
High Court rear range and end block: plan from roofs on the image, walls 8.5 m by estimate.
High Court side blocks are OSM ways 613586112 and 762198674, confirmed by matching red roofs on the image; tiled ranges cover their outer 55 percent as on the image, with heights assumed 9 m.
The two white-domed junction towers are seen only from above: plain square shaft and dome, 19 m shaft by estimate.
The dossier OSM block way 613586110 is mostly trees on the image, so it is not modelled.
All colours are starting tints from dossier samples or photos, affected by daylight and camera.
The game takes one suppress ring per landmark: this ring is the GPO (courtyard closed) and the modelled High Court buildings joined by a 1 m hairline over GPO Chowk.
